theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_mickle_rado_sup_lsc
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ψ : OuterMeasure (Eucl (m + 1))), (∀ (c : Eucl (m + 1)) (τ : ℝ), ψ (ball c τ) = ⨆ τ' ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ, ψ (ball c τ')) → ∀ r : ℝ, LowerSemicontinuous (fun c : Eucl (m + 1) => ⨆ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) r, ψ (ball c t) / ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (m + 1)))
